xmldoc.short_description: Write the record index of a length-delimited protobuf file.

param_input_item.param_description: one offset is stored every step records (1024 by default). A smaller step gives a finer index and a larger file.
the index file to write (default: the data file name followed by .pbidx).
a function handle f(n, total) called after each 64 MiB block scanned (bytes, file size).

param_output_item.param_description: a struct with Records (the number of complete records), Bytes (their size), Step, File and IndexFile.

description.p: protobuf.index scans a length-delimited file once and writes, next to it, a small index of record offsets. protobuf.read then uses the index with 'Records' to reach the first wanted record without reading the records before it.
An index is used only while the file keeps the size and modification time it had when the index was written, so it is rebuilt after the file changes.

example_item.example_item_description: Index a file and read a range of records
